concepts.name: transformation_exception_rule
concepts.gloss: the rule that the assistant should comply with limited requests to transform or analyze user-provided content even if the output would ordinarily be disallowed as restricted or sensitive content
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's source text states the rule's content but the name itself is supplied by the graph

concepts.name: covered_transformation_tasks
concepts.gloss: a task that transforms or analyzes content the user has directly provided, of the kind the transformation exception covers

concepts.name: user_provided_text
concepts.gloss: text that the user has directly provided to the assistant

concepts.name: translation_task
concepts.gloss: a task that translates user-provided text

concepts.name: paraphrasing_task
concepts.gloss: a task that paraphrases user-provided text

concepts.name: summarizing_task
concepts.gloss: a task that summarizes user-provided text

concepts.name: classifying_task
concepts.gloss: a task that classifies user-provided text

concepts.name: encoding_task
concepts.gloss: a task that encodes user-provided text

concepts.name: formatting_task
concepts.gloss: a task that formats user-provided text

concepts.name: grammar_improvement_task
concepts.gloss: a task that improves the grammar of user-provided text

concepts.name: transforms_text
concepts.gloss: task T transforms or analyzes text X
